agentNdx.evidence: XGuard is absent from the public AgentNDX index; attempted machine submissions returned redirects/HTTP 405, so no successful submission is claimed and the interactive curated-review flow is not bypassed

pulseMcp.evidence: the public submit page currently states submissions are paused; XGuard remains eligible for downstream discovery through its active Official MCP Registry metadata when PulseMCP ingestion resumes

ad402.evidence: 402.ad offers a free website submission path but the page includes Cloudflare Turnstile; its programmatic submission path costs $0.10 USDC, so no CAPTCHA bypass or paid submission was attempted

x402Watch.evidence: x402.watch exposes an Add facilitator flow but redirects to operator login/registration; no existing x402.watch credential is available

aiAgentMarketplace.evidence: AI Agent Marketplace/aiagenta2z allows public registration but its CLI/API submission path requires an AI_AGENT_MARKETPLACE_ACCESS_KEY from an account; no such credential is available

openModelsMcpRegistry.evidence: public registry accepts remote http-streaming servers through servers/{id}.yaml plus a pull request; the connected GitHub App cannot create a new external fork

paySkills.evidence: the public pay-skills catalog currently requires paid endpoints to return valid Solana-mainnet 402 challenges accepting USDC or USDT; XGuard's public facilitator gateway is Base mainnet and is not a paid provider endpoint for this catalog

x402Scout.evidence: registry requires an x402-gated endpoint with provider wallet and auth_required=false; XGuard verify/settle use API key plus prepaid service balance, so registering there would be inaccurate

index402.evidence: 402 Index self-registration verifies a paid endpoint that directly returns protocol payment challenges; XGuard is a facilitator safety gateway rather than a directly x402-gated resource
